title: 第11章 惊天逆转第12章 申请死刑核准
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
画面中，田英光三人和王乐乐的面容都非常的清晰。
整个画面也非常的亮。
只见王乐乐畏畏缩缩，面露恐惧的从抽屉里拿出了一叠钞票。
当著三人的面数了一叠钱交给了田英光，视频中传出声音，是王乐乐在说保护费之类的。
下一刻，田英光又將王乐乐手中的剩余的钞票抢了过去。
“呵呵，现在一个月保护费上升到1万了。”
画面中，田英光的话语被清晰的记录了下来，同时记录的还有他们三人那贪婪的目光。
尤其是抢钱的那一幕，从五官，神態，动作全都被记录下来，还是从两个角度。
就仿佛是有人特意录下来一样。
做完一切的三人欢心的离开。
看完这一段，视频就黑了。
此刻，整个法庭，所有人全都瞪大了眼睛！
包括审判长王正华，两个审判员等等法院人员。
黄轩本来一脸轻描淡写，还无比轻鬆的喝了一口水。
结果看到这个场面，口里的水直接喷了出来。
我去！
看著屏幕瞪大了眼睛。
全网的直播间內，所有观眾也都愣住了，所有的法评人露出了震惊的神態。
“咳咳，还没完，请大家继续观看。”
林默冷声提醒道。

接著，黑屏的画面又再度出现。
视频上的日期来到了第二天。
又是四个人出现在了画面中，三人又从王乐乐手里拿走了一叠钞票。
画面一转，日期又过了一天，这一天，有两段画面。
三人来拿了两次钱！
到这里，视频播放结束。
整个法院寂静如水。
这时候，林默眼神犀利，冷冷的开口：
“审判长，田英光三人，分別在4月25日，26日，27日三天，以收保护费为由，五次进入王乐乐家中抢夺了五万元，每次为一万元，三人的行为已经完全构成了入室抢劫罪，我申请以入室抢劫罪，多次且数额巨大，判处三人死刑！”
所有人听闻直接惊掉了下巴！
炸裂！
太炸裂了！
死刑啊！
各大直播间本来垂头观眾们，瞬间兴奋了起来：
“臥槽！有这证据，林律师怎么不早拿出来！”
“我的个天王老子嘞！这....这....我只能说林大律师牛逼！”
content_en:
In the picture, the faces of Tian Yingguang, the three of them and Wang Lele are all very clear.
The whole screen is also very bright.
I saw Wang Lele cowering and taking out a stack of banknotes from the drawer with a look of fear on his face.
In front of the three people, he counted a stack of money and handed it to Tian Yingguang. A voice came out in the video. It was Wang Lele talking about protection fees and the like.
The next moment, Tian Yingguang snatched the remaining banknotes from Wang Lele's hand.
"Haha, the monthly protection fee has now risen to 10,000."
In the picture, Tian Yingguang's words were clearly recorded, as well as the greedy eyes of the three of them.
Especially the money-grabbing scene, the facial features, expressions, and movements were all recorded, from two angles.
It was as if someone had recorded it on purpose.
After finishing everything, the three people left happily.
After watching this section, the video went black.
At this moment, everyone in the entire court widened their eyes!
Including presiding judge Wang Zhenghua, two judges and other court personnel.
Huang Xuan had an understatement on his face, but he took a sip of water with great ease.
As a result, when I saw this scene, the water in my mouth spurted out.
I'm going!
His eyes widened as he looked at the screen.
All the viewers in the live broadcast room on the entire network were stunned, and all the legal commentators showed shocked expressions.
"Ahem, it's not over yet, please continue watching."
Lin Mo reminded coldly.
Then, the black screen appeared again.
The date on the video came to the next day.
Four more people appeared on the screen, and the three of them took a stack of banknotes from Wang Lele's hand.
As soon as the scene changed, another day passed. On this day, there were two scenes.
Three people came and took the money twice!
Here, the video playback ends.
The whole court was as silent as water.
At this time, Lin Mo's eyes were sharp and he said coldly:
"The presiding judge, Tian Yingguang, entered Wang Lele's home five times on April 25, 26, and 27 and robbed 50,000 yuan, each time worth 10,000 yuan, on the pretext of collecting protection fees. The behavior of the three has completely constituted the crime of home invasion and robbery. I apply to sentence them to death for the crime of home invasion and robbery, which occurred multiple times and in huge amounts!"
Everyone's jaw dropped when they heard it!
Explode!
It’s so explosive!
Death penalty!
Audiences in major live broadcast rooms who had bowed their heads suddenly became excited:
"Damn it! With this evidence, why didn't Lawyer Lin bring it out earlier!"
"Oh my God! This... this... I can only say that Lawyer Lin is awesome!"
